title: Enhanced pilot photo shows slanted hangar doors at Papoose Lake

tellings.quote: Luigi also shows Bob a high-quality aerial photograph taken by a pilot roughly [music] 17 miles from Papoose Lake.

plain: A high-quality aerial photograph, taken by a pilot about 17 miles from Papoose Lake, a dry lake bed in the Nevada desert, is said to show slanted hangar doors once it is enhanced. Michels tells how a researcher named Luigi Vendittelli showed the photo to Bob Lazar, a man who says he once worked at a hidden facility there, while Michels spent two days with Lazar. If the doors are real, they would point to a hidden base where Lazar says one stood.
